findings.title: On the only real `hermes gateway status` output shape on record, a healthy channel probes UNDETERMINED rather than REACHABLE — the channel row (`WhatsApp: paired`) is exclusive for health but `paired` is negatives-only, and the `Gateway: running` row above it is barred from promoting, so the positive `ok:` line is effectively unreachable for the observed CLI. The tradeoff is deliberate and argued in the file; worth revisiting once a healthy installation has actually been read.
